GUESS WHO PASSED ALL HIS EXAMS WITHOUT ATTENDING ANY OF HIS ONLINE COURSES AND STUDYING 2 DAYS BEFORE FINALS AND SURVIVING LU AND THIS SHITTY YEAR WITH A 15/20 GPA. M1 IN CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGY ✅ M2, IM READY FOR THE CHALLENGES AND ALL THE THESIS WORK.

I couldn’t even breathe, so I stayed in my bed curled up watching my series and decided to postpone the semester to next year. I felt like I was at rock bottom again. Then it hit me, I’ve hit rock bottom before -too many times for one lifetime if you ask me- and I survived it.

I reminded myself that I don’t really need to attend courses in order to pass them. I reminded myself that I’ve done this so many times before, that I’ve got this. That I’m majoring in something that I am passionate about and that like everything I do in my life I do it in my own

I believe that it’s an art; understanding people, sharing their pain and helping them get passed it with empathy is an art. Despite all the doubts I had about myself I dove in and presented my exams. Honestly, I’m so glad I did.

This semester had a lot of challenging big courses and I was worried that I’m playing with fire, which I’ve done many times before. My friends were so supportive, we helped each other out with studying that it actually became fun.

I was even impressed by my ability to read a course one time and then explain it to the whole class. I realized how far I’ve come in psychology and how much I understand things even though I don’t read psychology related books.

With all the chaos happening outside and inside of me I managed to get a 15/20 GPA without attendance and by just reading the courses. The point of all of this is firstly to celebrate myself. I need to do that more often.

So yeah I built a wall. I could blame it on timing, on distance, on choices that affected a couple of relationships that could have been the real deal but I decided that I’m done with making excuses to people. I deserve so much better. I deserve to be fought for.
